messages:
maya: Quick question — proposal to add small-window prefetch param to paginator to reduce tail latency for short result sets. RFC: https://redwood-internal/rfcs/prefetch-window
sam: +1 curious how this interacts with transport retries/backoff. If prefetch triggers parallel calls we need idempotency guarantees
li: Right — want to avoid duplicate processing. Proposal: prefetch only on read-only endpoints and make client use opt-in header `x-prefetch-window`.
toni: Also need server-side quota accounting. Prefetch increases tokens/requests. Could blow budgets for bursty clients :grimacing:
maya: example API sketch:
```python
# python
class Paginator:
    def __init__(self, prefetch=0):
        self.prefetch = prefetch
    def __iter__(self):
        ...
```
```ts
// ts
interface PaginatorOpts { prefetch?: number }
```
```go
// go
type Paginator struct { Prefetch int }
```
sam: For transports: streaming vs paged: streaming avoids prefetch but needs resumable cursors. Prefetch is for paged transports
li: If prefetch spawns parallel page fetches we must be careful with retries — use request dedupe key (nonce) and server-side idempotent token
toni: Suggest transport-level leaky-bucket: allow prefetch only if client has available budget, else fall back to single fetch
maya: thoughts on making prefetch a per-route config in console? Devs can enable per-route to control cost
sam: sounds good. Also add telemetry: prefetch_hits, wasted_prefetch_tokens, prefetch_latency_savings
li: small nit: name it `prefetch_window` vs `prefetch`? window is nicer for readability
maya: agree `prefetch_window`.
infra-bot: deploy-checker: note that adding header x-prefetch-window needs API-gateway + quota changes — ticket #INFR-412
maya: action items: (1) sam to add transport dedupe token design (2) li to spec server-side idempotency token (3) toni to prototype quota budget check in gateway
sam: I'll start a mini-RFC doc and PR with sketches. ping @li @toni when ready
li: I'll draft idempotency API and edge cases (retries, partial page failures)
toni: will sketch gateway budget heuristic and add unit tests
maya: thanks team — let's sync next Wed 11am. :thumbsup:
